questions.q:
The piecewise functions $f$ and $g$ are given.

$f(x) = \begin{cases} -x^2 & \text{for } x < 0 \\ 1 - x & \text{for } x \ge 0 \end{cases}$

$g(x) = \begin{cases} |x| + 7 & \text{for } x \le -1 \\ x - 3 & \text{for } x > -1 \end{cases}$

What is the value of $f(g(-1))$?
questions.explain: First, evaluate the inner function $g(-1)$. Since $-1$ falls into the condition $x \le -1$ for the function $g$, we use the top rule: $g(-1) = |-1| + 7 = 1 + 7 = 8$. Next, evaluate the outer function with this result, $f(8)$. Since 8 falls into the condition $x \ge 0$ for function $f$, we use the bottom rule: $f(8) = 1 - 8 = -7$.
